description: Administrative project data: Bauherr, Planer, Ausfuehrungsbetrieb, project location, dates.
Confirm scope: pond, basin, stream, swim/bathing pond, retention basin, etc. Exclude landfills, fisheries, dams, waterways.
Required authorities, permits (LBO, WHG), insurance and safety obligations (Absturzsicherung, Ertrinken).
Define water-body function (Loeschwasser, RRB, Schwimmteich etc.) which drives material, dimensions, protection measures.
Document mechanical, thermal, chemical and biological loads; Wassereinwirkungsklasse W1-B...W3-B; Rissklasse R0-B...R3-B; Standort S1-B/S2-B.
Subsoil investigation, frost depth, bearing capacity, fines content, presence of stones, organic matter.
Profile design; material-specific slope limits per Tab. 1 (1:1...1:5 depending on Werkstoff).
Gewaessertrennung, accommodation of building movements / cracks, ice-pressure protection.
Select sealing type considering usage, geometry, einwirkungsklasse, root/rhizome aggressiveness; CE/EU-BauPVO/MVV-TB compliance check.
Design with raw/homogenised/vacuum-pressed clay (Grubentone); kf, organic content, calcium content, compaction.
Bentonite, clay-meal, polymer additives; admixed-in-place / plant-mixed; Eignungspruefung essential.
Ortbeton / Spritzbeton / Elementwaende / Fertigteile; high water-penetration resistance per DAfStb WU-Richtlinie.
Asphaltmastix, Gussasphalt, water-tight Asphaltbeton.
Geosynthetic clay liners (Bentonitmatten / GTD / GBR-C); Na- vs Ca-bentonite, geotextile cover, optional polyolefin coating.
Multi-layer bitumen and polymer-bitumen sheets (G 200 DD, PV 200 DD, PYE PV 200 S5 etc.) per DIN 18535-2 / DIN 18533-2.
PVC-P, EPDM, EVA, FPO, PIB, TPE, ECB sheets; thickness >= 1.2 mm (1.0 mm for prefab garden ponds); joint widths.
Liquid-applied plastic sealing per DIN 18531-2 / DIN 18533-3 with classification per Annex 3 (M/S, W1-W3, P1-P4, S1-S4, TL/TH).
PELD / PEHD sheets; PEHD has inherent root/rhizome resistance (no FLL test required); PELD requires FLL root-resistance proof.
V2A (1.4301), V4A (1.4401), V5A (1.4539) and weather-resistant CorTen steels; zinc-coating thickness >= 100 micrometers for unalloyed steel.
Sodium/lithium/potassium water-glass admixed in clay/loam soils; potassium-water-glass only is plant-compatible.
Prefabricated GRP / glass-reinforced unsaturated polyester elements; manufacturer's edge formation predominates.
Above / below abdichtung protection vs. mechanical, thermal, chemical loads; Schutzwirksamkeitsklassen per DIN EN 13719.
Min. height of edge above water-line (>= 5 cm to terrain, >= 30 cm to building, reducible to >= 15 cm with adapted fastening).
Plant choice, rhizome aggressiveness (Phragmites, Typha etc.), test methods (FLL-Wurzelpruefung, Rhizompruefung).
All test categories: Voruntersuchung, Eignungspruefung, Eigenueberwachung, Fremdueberwachung, Kontrollpruefung.
Formal acceptance, 5-year defects-liability period including vegetation work where bundled with sealing work.
Activation of pumps / Notueberlauf, first filling, fold smoothing, function checks of capillary barrier and overflow.
Minimum yearly inspection (DIN 31051); maintenance concept (intervals, scope); repair triggers.
Aggregation of all section results, verdict (compliant / compliant-with-conditions / not-compliant), engineer + customer sign-off.
